classification: Linux app-root decoder ownership and held-file identity preconditions; no installed updater or supported-Worker metadata adaptation acceptance

plan.acceptance: Workers and repeated initializers never read or close the shared root decoder; stale descriptor-slot reuse returns no UID and leaves subsequent correct metadata and liveness usable. Invalid native messages still retire the port.

do: Main-thread, one-attempt initialization is claimed before namespace lookup, descriptor observation, read or close; malformed first identity cannot be retried.
Conditional request kind6 carries exact u64 device/inode and u32 mode; distinct reply kind7 retains the existing bounded protocol. The client never retries the older unconditional request.

The owner duplicates the target through the held root pidfd, stats that held object once, and compares the expected tuple before publishing its UID. This is a held-object precondition, not an atomic caller-slot comparison.

Closed unavailable/stale statuses have zero metadata and preserve the healthy port. Wrong successful tuples, invalid/reserved fields, mismatched targets/kinds and delayed replies retain permanent retirement. Out-of-range local tuples perform no I/O.

client.scope: Full security suite includes these50 decoder controls; retained failure-first client log has10fail/40healthy before conditional protocol implementation.

actualKernel.cases: Actual close/dup2 forced same-slot reuse, stale then matching owner query and same-channel liveness; real BFF repeated-main/Worker initializer refusal followed by live root channel; seven malformed conditional-frame controls plus retained native generation tests.
actualKernel.qualificationPolicy: Digest-pinned existing image; all capabilities dropped, no new privileges, no network, read-only repository/root. seccomp unconfined only in the declared isolated kernel fixture, never product policy.

client.scope: Actual decoder source in independent CPU ports, including every reserved refusal byte, u64 goldens and lifetime guards; not native execution.

heldKernel.scope: Independent identical C fixture fails source58 and passes candidate59 using actual full launcher/header, real self pidfd_getfd, socket credentials, mode/dev/ino changes, closed slots and no descriptor leak. Separate from the namespaced real BFF lane.

act.next: Adapt supported report/ANN Workers through a private bounded metadata/probe port backed by the already selected main scope; retain main-thread-only writer and caller-owned failure evidence.

limits: Initial detached app lifetime, authenticated coordinator placement outside the old namespace, distinct installed/running/successor ownership and process/signal consumers remain open.
Actual installed cross-version and two successive updates, graceful drain/restart, cancellation, recovery/rollback and SSD/state continuity are not qualified by these controls.
